name: APIVerveCountryBoundaries
summary: Country Boundaries retrieves GeoJSON border outlines for any country by its two-letter ISO code.
description:
Country Boundaries retrieves GeoJSON border outlines for any country by its two-letter ISO code. Each response includes the country name, geometry type, and boundary coordinate pairs ready for mapping layers.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Country Boundaries from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
